text:
maria: Short postmortem follow-up: we keep seeing the KV churn spike. Let's create a compact incident cheatsheet (one paragraph) + exact safe commands and owners. No long prose.

kevin: I can do the cheatsheet and open a PR. I'll keep it to 3 bullets and include CLI snippets.

sam: I'll attach the small diagnostic note explaining why prefix-heavy traffic blows up the KV size distribution.

lisa: Product wants an explicit "customer toggle" rollback step and a short template to ping customers when we flip thresholds for Dedicated tenants.

akshay: oncall: please include a single-button mitigation path in alerts (approved action) so we don't paste commands during pagers. Also add the exact PromQL we should look at.

maria: Draft cheatsheet (one-paragraph): Verify the spike, make cache read-only for the offending model, scale pool or shift traffic to quantified fallback, and then file a follow-up. Keep language prescriptive.

kevin: CLI snippets I'm planning to include (to be vetted):
```
# mark model cache read-only
rwctl model update --id model-foo --set cache.read_only=true
# emergency add replicas
rwctl capacity modify --pool model-foo-pool --replicas +2
# shift all traffic to fallback
rwctl traffic migrate --from model-foo --to model-foo-fb --percent 100
```
I'll put these in a PR: https://git.internal/rw/docs/pulls/2045 (WIP).

maria: Add exact PromQL for alerting: `sum by(model)(rate(kv_evictions_total[1m])) > 40` and `histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(request_duration_seconds_bucket[5m])) by (le,model)) > 0.5` as a p95 latency check.

sam: I'll paste a 3-line explainer about how long-prefix requests increase KV cardinality and a short synthetic script for the harness into the PR.

lisa: Product notification snippet (for the runbook): `@product-alerts Subject: KV eviction threshold changed for <tenant>. Body: action, reason, rollback-instructions, contact.` Add a one-sentence customer-facing rollback note.

akshay: I'll open INFRA ticket to add a safe alert action: INFRA-2202. It will run the rwctl command behind an approval modal and log actions. RBAC: oncall+eng-sre.

ops-bot: Created action RB-2045 assigned to kevin, due 1769999400.

kevin: Proposed owners & timeline: kevin -> PR by Thu EOD (1769999400), sam -> attach tests & harness by Mon (1770172200), maria -> staging smoke & merge by Wed (1770345000), akshay -> infra ticket done by Fri (1770431400).

maria: Agree. Add a one-line decision tree at the top: When eviction metric above threshold AND p95 latency rising -> contain -> shift -> notify. Keep it readable by pager-scanners.

kevin: I'll add a TL;DR header to the top of the page and a "what to paste" box for the alert UI (single click).

sam: Co-owning tests & will add load script link in PR.

lisa: I'll write and commit the product-notify template to the PR.

akshay: Will follow up with infra on RBAC scope for the mitigation action.

rb-bot: Reminder: update postmortem action tracker when RB-2045 changes state.

maria: Final checklist before close:
- [ ] kevin: open PR and address comments (RB-2045)
- [ ] sam: add synthetic harness and attach results
- [ ] maria: smoke-test in staging and sign-off
- [ ] akshay: infra ticket & RBAC for alert action
- [ ] lisa: product notification template committed

kevin: Will ping reviewers Thursday morning. If someone's bandwidth changes, swap ownership here.

maria: Thanks all. We'll reconvene after merge to confirm infra automation follow-up. If anything slips, escalate in this thread. :thumbsup:
